title: Ruined Mirror-Dream Gallery
text: A rare circular ruin on the surface of the Mirror-Dream Border. A crystal path crosses the central shallow pool. One gallery remains passable while the other bears broken roofs or walls.

The pool's Crystal Ball mainly holds Dream Crystals, sometimes light or dark microcores or a Dream Spell Core. Each side gallery has a central Crystal Ball containing Paradox Dust, with chances for a Dream Spell Core, Dream Crystal Budding Rock, an Arcane Crystal Grid or a Pocket Magic Bottle.
